title: Spring Core & IoC
intro: Spring Core interviews test whether you understand the container, not just the annotations. This module is an elevation arc: it opens with dependency injection (the central idea — IoC, the types constructor/setter/field, the BeanFactory vs ApplicationContext container), then the bean lifecycle (the hooks interviewers probe). Spring internals and custom components follow at the mechanics tier, then AOP (proxies, pointcuts, advice) and Spring events. It closes with comparisons and scenario-based questions.
